result.question: Who was Athaliah not able to kill?

readings.support: Joash son of Ahaziah | to hide him from Athaliah, and he was not killed

assessments.reason: 2 Kings 11:2-3 states that Joash son of Ahaziah was hidden from Athaliah and “he was not killed,” directly answering that Athaliah was not able to kill Joash.

result.reason: The passage explicitly says Joash was hidden from Athaliah and was not killed.
